wordHints.Swing: Swing (Playground Equipment): A suspended seat that moves back and forth
wordHints.Slide: Slide (Playground Structure): An inclined plane for sliding down
wordHints.Rock wall: Rock wall (Climbing Structure): Vertical surface with artificial handholds

wordHints.Seesaw: Seesaw (Play Equipment): A balanced board that pivots in the middle

faqs.question: Are all playgrounds required to have these items?
faqs.answer: No, playground equipment can vary, but these are common features found in many playgrounds.

faqs.question: Why are these items specifically chosen for playgrounds?
faqs.answer: These items promote physical development, social interaction, and motor skills in children while being fun and engaging.
